Prasidh Krishna Out of India’s ODI Series Against New Zealand

04 Nov 2026, 10:29 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.icc-cricket.com

1 min read

Key takeawaysMedical staff have determined that he requires additional time to increase his workload before returning to competitive international cricket.

Injury Update

Indian fast bowler Prasidh Krishna has been ruled out of the upcoming five-match ODI series against New Zealand. According to reports, the decision follows the bowler's inability to secure the necessary fitness clearance. Krishna, who was initially included in the squad subject to his recovery, is currently rehabilitating from a hamstring injury sustained during the tour of England.

Medical staff have determined that he requires additional time to increase his workload before returning to competitive international cricket.

Squad Adjustments and Upcoming Fixtures

  • Nitish Kumar Reddy: The all-rounder remains with the main squad only for the series opener on 4 November in Auckland. Following this match, he will join the India A side to prepare for the ICC World Test Championship series starting 19 November 2026.
  • Mohammed Siraj: Siraj is set to join the India A squad for their second four-day match to gain preparation time for the Test series.

ODI Series Schedule

The five-match ODI series is scheduled as follows:

  • 1st ODI: 4 November, Auckland
  • 2nd ODI: 7 November, Wellington
  • 3rd ODI: 10 November, Hamilton
  • 4th ODI: 13 November, Mount Maunganui
  • 5th ODI: 15 November, Mount Maunganui

Spectators and fans are encouraged to check the official ICC website or the BCCI portal for the most recent squad announcements and match status updates as the series progresses.
